crossRefs.note: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works…
For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I…
By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through…

translations.web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
translations.bsb: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
translations.kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
translations.asv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.
